name: Jurassic Attack

specialAbility.name: Dino Chomp
specialAbility.description: Jurassic Attack opens its massive T-Rex jaws and takes a giant bite out of the competition!

lore: Deep in a prehistoric jungle, scientists found a real T-Rex fossil — and built a monster truck around it! Jurassic Attack has actual dinosaur teeth on its bumper, scaly green armor, and a roar so loud it shakes the whole arena. When it chomps down, even the toughest trucks run for cover!
